name: Fileship
description: Your own ShareX server and file cloud, with AI search that runs on your server.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything: the database, uploaded files, thumbnails, backups, AI models, Fileship's encryption key (fileship/secret.key), the database passwords and admin-password.txt. Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Fileship dashboard, API, uploads and share links, published on host as 6131

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Fileship at, like http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6131 (for example http://192.168.1.20:6131), or your own domain. Fileship works from any address without it, but links in emails and single sign-on only work once localhost is changed.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first password for the admin account. Leave it blank and the app makes one on first start and shows it in the app log. It is only used until you change the password in Fileship.
